teaching_evidence.claim: VLM emits differentiable PyTorch reward; VLM generation is off-graph; rewards are differentiated with respect to sampled actions
RGB-D/SAM/DINOv2 features produce 3D keypoints; stage-specific rewards guide action denoising
Gradient guidance, candidate diversity and FK resampling are distinct mechanisms
LeRobot pi0.5 with/without VLS is 23.69 to36.81 average SR, +13.12pp; other TableI models are unsteered comparisons
CALVIN ablation full88%, no gradient17.3%, no FK85.3%, no RBF86.0%
Real Franka uses frozen pi0.5. Fig5 score awards0.5 for grasping correct object and1 for full task, so69% ID and40% mug-OOD are partial-credit score means, not established full-success rates

teaching_evidence.claim: At pinned official code commit, sample.detach().requires_grad_(True) through action postprocessing and EE mapping; autograd.grad(reward,sample) and normalized gradient; no_grad base sampling; xyz-only corrections
Flow code uses negative dt1->0 and subtracts reward gradient from velocity; paper Eq5 displays plus. Explained at convention level rather than silently merging
Paper Eq10 sigmoid has sign/normalization ambiguity for negative rewards, whereas code decreasing sigmoid in normalized progress matches stated intention
